title: Yei language
description: Yam language spoken in South Papua, Indonesia
extract: Yei is a Papuan language spoken along the upper reaches of the Maro River, in the Merauke, South Papua, Indonesia. The Upper and Lower Yey dialects are only mutually intelligible with difficulty.
